analysis.estimand: Strictly paired single-factor check that execution.node_process_delay_s moves ONLY the satellite node-processing stage, ON A DESIGN WHERE THE DECISION STAGE IS ACTIVE. execution.compute_delay_s is 0.05 in BOTH arms (shared, not a factor), so every decision consumes simulated time and decision_compute_s is non-zero and discriminating; the single factor is execution.node_process_delay_s (0.0 vs 0.05). Requirement: with the timeline spans supplied, node_process_s is a separate named term and decision_compute_s closes to (decisions x compute_delay_s) per arm, and the UNLABELLED reading exceeds the labelled one by exactly the node total. Descriptive structural check, NOT an effect size, superiority or causal claim.

planned_contrasts.estimand: Paired structural comparison of the SAME trace/seed/config differing only in execution.node_process_delay_s (0.0 vs 0.05), with compute_delay_s=0.05 shared by both arms. Tested property: (a) supplying the timeline spans separates node_process_s from decision_compute_s; (b) without the spans the uncovered set absorbs F2 exactly; (c) per arm the labelled decision_compute_s closes to decisions x compute_delay_s. NOT an effect-size, performance or causal claim.
planned_contrasts.name: f2_vs_control

can_claim: the F2 node-processing stage is separately attributable on the timeline sink and is disjoint from the decision stage
on this fixture the e2e increase between arms equals the recorded node-processing occupancy

the unlabelled uncovered-interval reading exceeds the labelled decision-compute reading by exactly the node total, i.e. F2 would be misreported as decision compute if the timeline spans were not supplied
cannot_claim: any algorithmic superiority, information value, learning value or new-mechanism contribution
an effect-size, performance curve, threshold or causal claim about node processing delay
real subscriber traffic or a calibrated demand model
that this design is executable by the canonical remote runner today: remote_job.py never passes the timeline stream F2 requires

that the per-link utilisation, queue, tx and propagation phases are bit-identical between arms: a 0.05 s shift can move an availability window across the 0.1 s sampling boundary, so that comparison is REPORTED, not asserted
that the min_delivered_packets / min_multisat_deliveries acceptance values are enforced on the local execution route used here: they live only in the canonical remote runner

design_accounting.independent_condition_rule: one independent condition per unique resolved config SHA256
